source_provenance.reference: Independent exact-head review of fda1ad0 against Issue #415: local validation-receipt reuse did not bind reuse to the current HEAD

findings.permanent_disposition_evidence: Confirmed on the reviewed head: hunter_pr_preflight._reuse_blocker() called receipts.reuse_blocker(root) without a head, reuse_blocker defaulted head_sha to None, and verify() skipped the head comparison entirely -- so a receipt recorded for commit A could be reused on a different commit B carrying the same tree, definition and toolchain. The push boundary passed the head and the local reuse path did not, and nothing detected the divergence. Repaired by removing the default: verify() now requires head_sha, so no caller can drop the binding by omitting a keyword, and reuse_blocker resolves the head from the repository when a caller has not already established one. The regression drives the production caller with two real commits that resolve to the same tree, and was confirmed to fail against the pre-fix code and pass against the repair.

This can mislead reviewers into clearing a security-sensitive trust-root change using stale evidence, so regenerate the acceptance claims around the governed repin before relying on this request.
